properties.definition: delta_usd_month = a - b (positive: cell is costlier for a); delta_rel_usd_month = (a - min a) - (b - min b), i.e. compares each student's premium over their own best cell; delta_pct_rank = cost percentile of the cell for a minus for b (scale-free; +1 = best for b, worst for a)
